business_problem: Siemens Healthineers needed one governed platform for employee and supplier services, because fragmented departmental processes and manual support work made it harder to deliver consistent HR experiences, strengthen contract management, and introduce autonomous AI while staying compliant.
solution_summary: Siemens Healthineers is using ServiceNow as an employee and supplier engagement layer built around AI Agents, Employee Center, HR Service Delivery, and Supplier Lifecycle Operations. Employee Center is the front door for more than 115 HR services and 850-plus knowledge articles in eight languages, while HR Service Delivery provides the case-management model for employee support. AI Agents such as Agent Zero and the Payslip Explanation Agent use ticket patterns and knowledge to classify, resolve, or escalate inquiries with context. Supplier Lifecycle Operations extends the same platform principles to the One Supplier Portal, where procurement teams manage supplier documents, contacts, contract insights, and stakeholder coordination in one place. The result is a compliant-by-design AI operating model that links HR, procurement, and governance on one ServiceNow foundation.

solution_components.name: AI Agents
solution_components.role: Run Agent Zero and the Payslip Explanation Agent to classify, answer, resolve, or escalate HR inquiries.

solution_components.name: Employee Center
solution_components.role: Acts as the single employee portal for services, knowledge, and lifecycle interactions.

solution_components.name: HR Service Delivery
solution_components.role: Manages HR cases, routing, and employee-support workflows behind the portal and AI agents.

solution_components.name: Supplier Lifecycle Operations
solution_components.role: Coordinates supplier processes, documents, and stakeholder communication in the One Supplier Portal.

data_flow: Employees enter through Employee Center, where AI Agents use case history and knowledge articles to answer questions or open HR Service Delivery cases, then escalate unresolved work to human agents with full context. Procurement and supplier work flows through the same platform into Supplier Lifecycle Operations, where documents, contacts, and contract processes are coordinated with downstream business stakeholders.
business_outcome: Siemens Healthineers reached 75% employee adoption of its service portal, exposed 115-plus HR services through one engagement layer, positioned Agent Zero to handle about 9,000 cases per month, and created a compliant-by-design model for AI-assisted HR and procurement workflows.
metrics: ~9K Cases per month predicted to be handled by HR Agent Zero
115+ Active HR services available in Enterprise Services portal

architecture_clues: Agent Zero is being rolled out in North America first, with humans reviewing AI-resolved cases and two dedicated reviewers initially handling one in ten queries.
The platform includes an Alumni Service Center so the same engagement layer stays in place across the employment lifecycle.
AI governance is built into the operating model to align with the EU AI Act and platform-level visibility into agent usage and execution patterns.
